services.name: Cave Point Kayak Tour
services.desc: Experience This Door County Gem in Style 2 hours About Get prepared for an absolutely breathtaking experience as you paddle along the Lake Michigan shoreline. Experience first hand the wonders of Cave Point on this awesome kayak tour! Over a thousand years of wind and waves have worn away limestone cliffs to create underwater caves and tunnels that are only accessible from the water. Highlights Spectacular Shoreline Rock And Cave Formations 2 Hour Paddle Health & Safety Participants will not be permitted to participate if under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs or impairing Ages 5+ • 2 hours • Experience the beauty of Cave Point!

services.name: Clear Bottom Kayak Shipwreck Tour
services.desc: The Clear Bottom Kayak Tour in Door County 2 hours About Experience Door County’s historic maritime past in this exclusive Lakeshore Adventures Shipwreck Kayak Tour. Paddle over several 1800s wooden schooner shipwrecks with our clear bottom kayaks. This 2 hour paddle circumnavigates a small historic island with a 1820s Bird Cage Lighthouse on it. Paddle through the outer reef system and over as many wrecks as time and visibility permit. Highlights Sunken 1800's Schooners 1820's Bird Cage Lighthouse Scenic Shoreline & Outer Reef 2 Hour Paddle Health & Safety Participants will not be Ages 5+ • 2 hours • Our signature tour!

services.name: Bluff Kayak Tour
services.desc: 2 hours About Get ready to see some serious bluff formations as you paddle along the breathtaking shoreline of Hedge Hog Harbor and Door Bluff. Take in the amazing views of some of the largest limestone bluffs in the United States. This two hour tour departs from Garrett Bay, which is located near the tip of the Door Peninsula. You’ll see steep drop-offs and the remains of the wooden schooner shipwreck “Fleetwing” in the crystal clear water. All tours meet at Lakeshore Adventures main office 8113 Hwy 57 Baileys Harbor 15 minutes prior to your scheduled tour. You will be driving your Ages 5+ • 2 hours • Get Wowed by Picturesque Bluff Formations
